To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
silica nanoparticles can be successfully used in the preparation of rubber nanocomposites and that these nanocomposites have improved mechanical properties compared to neat rubber.
the use of epoxidized natural latex (ENL) in NR/ENL blends can improve the mechanical properties of NR and that the addition of ENL to NR/ENR blends can improve the tensile strength of NR/ENR.

the addition of epoxidized natural and/or solution styrene-butadiene rubber (ENR and SBR) to silica-based rubber compounds leads to a significant improvement of the mechanical properties of the rubber compounds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of silica-reinforced rubber compounds with improved properties for use in tire applications.
the development of new materials for the tire industry.
the synthesis and characterization of novel silica-based hybrid materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of silica to rubber results in a reduction in rolling resistance, a reduction in wet traction, and an increase in abrasion loss.
the use of silica as a filler in the production of tires has a positive impact on the environment.
the use of carbon black in tires is not harmful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of epoxidized natural rubbers to the silica-filled rubber compound improves the mechanical properties and wear resistance of the rubber composites.
silica-based rubber compounds can have better mechanical properties, lower rolling resistance, and lower heat build-up than carbon black-based compounds.
the silica-filled SBR rubber compound is a promising alternative to the conventional carbon black filled compound for the production of tires.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of silica to rubber can be a very effective way of increasing the stiffness of the material, and that it can do so without sacrificing the rubber’s ability to stretch.

the silica filler is the main contributor to the improvement in the mechanical properties, while the epoxidized NR and solution styrene-butadiene rubber (SSBR) play an important role in the reduction of rolling resistance and hysteresis losses.
silica can improve the performance of a rubber compound, even if it is not a tire rubber compound.
